anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

## Aliases

| Alias | Value |
|---|---|
| ROOT | `/work/widget` |
| W | `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` (`<name>` = `fix-retry`, from `fix/retry` with `/` → `-`) |
| A | `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa` (headRefOid, short `aaaaaaa`) |
| B | `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb` (origin/main, short `bbbbbbb`) |
| C | `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc` (short `ccccccc`) |
| D | `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd` (short `ddddddd`) |

The caller passed PR values, so this run follows `reference/pr-head.md` instead of Steps 0 and 1. The process cwd never changes, and every command targets a path with `-C`.

## Shared discovery (D1–D9)

| # | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| D1 | `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir` (session cwd) | Common dir is `/work/widget/.git`, so ROOT = ROOT |
| D2 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` | Empty, so not a submodule |
| D3 | Overrides ladder: `ROOT/.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, `ROOT/gauntlet-overrides.md`, `ROOT/doc/gauntlet-overrides.md`; read `ROOT/.pi/settings.json` | No file except in the override row. No native tool or wrapper, so home = W |
| D4 | `git -C ROOT fetch origin` | Succeeds |
| D5 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse --verify -q A^{commit}`, then `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/fix/retry` | Commit exists; remote branch = A |
| D6 | `git -C ROOT rev-parse origin/main` | BASE_SHA = B |
| D7 | Fork check: is `isCrossRepository` true? | false |
| D8 | `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain` | `fix/retry` is not checked out elsewhere |
| D9 | `git -C ROOT show-ref --verify refs/heads/fix/retry` | No local branch (default) |

## Shared success tail (S1–S6, legend R)

| # | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | `git -C ROOT worktree list --porcelain` | Contains `worktree W` |
| S2 | `git -C W branch --show-current` | `fix/retry` |
| S3 | `git -C W rev-parse HEAD` | A. Capture PRE_REWORK_HEAD = A and BASE_SHA = B |
| S4 | `git -C W merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main` | Already up to date. Record `merge: no-op - head contains origin/main` (no commit) |
| S5 | `git -C W merge-base --is-ancestor A HEAD` | Exit 0 |
| S6 | Provenance note | Skipped on all rows. Fresh rows: `git -C ROOT symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` returns empty, so the note is skipped silently. Reuse row: Step 0-like path, so no note applies |

**Report R:**
```
Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
Branch: fix/retry
Base: fix/retry @ aaaaaaa
PR: acme/widget#82
Pre-rework head: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
Base SHA: bbbbbbb
merge: no-op - head contains origin/main
Ready to implement PR #82 rework
```

**Fresh-creation clean check (FC):** `git -C ROOT status --porcelain` returns empty with exit 0, so the base is clean.

## Provisioning rows

| Row | Delta from the shared legend |
|---|---|
| linked | D1 is run from `/work/widget/.worktrees/other`, but the common dir still yields ROOT. The session tree `other` is not the selected home on `fix/retry`, so I neither adopt it nor nest a tree inside it. Steps: D2–D9, FC, then `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry`. Git's unique-remote DWIM performs `--track -b fix/retry W origin/fix/retry`; the caller supplies no `-b`. Then S1–S6 and R. |
| primary | Identical to linked, with D1 run from ROOT. |
| ancestor | D9 finds a local branch at C. `git -C ROOT merge-base --is-ancestor fix/retry origin/fix/retry` exits 0. After FC, run `git -C ROOT update-ref refs/heads/fix/retry origin/fix/retry`, never `branch -f`. Then `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry` checks out the existing branch (no DWIM, no `-b`). Then S1–S6 and R. |
| reuse | D8 lists W on `fix/retry`. This is the selected home, so it is not a stop. The ancestry check at C exits 0. Step 3 runs `git -C W status --porcelain`, which is clean. Then `git -C W merge --ff-only origin/fix/retry` and `git -C W rev-parse HEAD` returns A. No creation and no FC. Then S4–S6 and R. |
| fork | Stops at D7: `PR #82's head lives on fork contributor/widget; rework needs an in-repo branch.` Boundary: after the D4–D6 reads, before FC and before any file or worktree write. |
| elsewhere | Stops at D8: `branch fix/retry is checked out at /work/widget/.worktrees/pr-82; finish or remove that worktree first.` Boundary: pre-write, before FC. |
| unreachable | D5 verification fails: `PR #82 head aaaaaaa is not reachable (origin/fix/retry is at ddddddd); the branch moved.` Boundary: right after fetch, before D6 and before any write. |
| moved | The commit verifies, but `origin/fix/retry` is D. The stop text is identical to unreachable, with the same boundary. |
| ahead / diverged | Two runs, same result. D9 finds the branch at C, and the ancestry check exits 1: `local branch fix/retry is at ccccccc, not an ancestor of origin/fix/retry (aaaaaaa); rework needs the PR head.` Boundary: before FC, `update-ref`, or `worktree add`. |
| override | D3 finds `create: helper create -b <branch> <name>`, which contains `-b`, so the override is skipped. After FC, run the built-in `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry` (DWIM). Then S1–S6, and R gains `create: override skipped (contains -b)` after the PR block. |
| race | After FC, `git -C ROOT worktree add W fix/retry` runs. S1 and S2 pass, but S3 returns D. The tree is left intact. Stop: `worktree /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry is at D, not PR #82 head A; the head raced after creation.` Nothing is merged and no R report is emitted. |

## History

All advances are merges, including later `git -C W merge origin/main` to keep the tree current. I never use `rebase`, and never use `reset` or `commit --amend` on a commit at or below A.

Two flow steps stay allowed:
- The appended-spec approval `commit --amend --no-edit`.
- The appended-wave fold `reset --soft "$WAVE_BASE_SHA"`, provided WAVE_BASE_SHA descends from A.

Both operate only above PRE_REWORK_HEAD.
